syntax: LAST_VALUE(value) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)
summary: LAST_VALUE reads the value from the last row of the window frame.
documentation: LAST_VALUE reads the value from the last row of the window frame. To repeat a final observation on every row, the frame must include rows after the current row. A default frame often stops at the current peer group and therefore does not mean the whole partition.
inputs: readings(id INTEGER, device TEXT, value INTEGER).
returns: id, device and final_value, ordered by device and id.
caution: The last row is defined by ordering, not by the largest measured value. A final NULL remains NULL; this does not search backward for a non-NULL value.
scenarios: Attach a final reading to each observation for comparison.
Repeat the latest recorded estimate alongside earlier revisions.
Show a closing value across all rows of a reporting group.
title: Repeat the final observation
problem: Return id, device and LAST_VALUE(value) over each device ordered by id AS final_value. Use a full-partition ROWS frame, and order output by device, id.
hint: The frame must end at UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING.
goal: Use LAST_VALUE() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
